The Neighboring Akala Island!'') is the eighth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== {{spoilers}} * {{adv|Moon}} receives {{TP|Moon|Rowlet}} from [[Professor Kukui]]. * {{adv|Sun}} receives a task to deliver special [[Mirage Berry|Mirage Berries]] to each of [[Alola]]'s [[guardian deities]], which he accepts after learning he will be paid. * [[Hala]] is revealed to have taken Sun's [[Sparkling Stone]] in order to fix it into [[Z-Ring|something]]. * The {{adv|Rotom Pokédex}} is revealed to be the {{p|Rotom}} Moon transported to Alola after it combined with a spare [[Pokédex]]. * Moon takes the Rotom Pokédex for herself while Sun is given his usual Pokédex back. * [[Gladion]] travels to the [[Ruins of Conflict]], only to find [[Guzma]] there instead of {{p|Tapu Koko}}. * Guzma enlists Gladion as a member of [[Team Skull]] as an Enforcer. * Sun, Moon, and Professor Kukui arrive at [[Heahea City]] on [[Akala Island]]. * Professor Kukui heads off to talk to his wife, [[Professor Burnet]]. * Sun and Moon meet [[Lana]], [[Kiawe]], and [[Mallow]], the [[Trial Captain]]s of Akala Island. * Kiawe challenges Sun to a battle to see if he's worthy enough of doing the [[island challenge]]. * The battle ends without a winner, but Kiawe accepts Sun. * Lana, still unconvinced about Sun, tells everyone to follow her to [[Brooklet Hill]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Professor Kukui]] * [[Lana]] * [[Kiawe]] * [[Mallow]] * [[Hala]] * [[Olivia]] (fantasy) * [[Nanu]] (fantasy) * [[Guzma]] * [[Gladion]] * {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Meowth}} ([[Cent]];
